description: Scrape Amazon's Today's Deals grid by category, discount, price, collection and Prime status across 23 marketplaces. Includes rating, deal window and product details.

brand.description: Case-insensitive brand name substring (e.g. Anker, Samsung). Leave empty for all brands.
brand.title: Brand

categories.description: Amazon departments to scan. Common names: Electronics, Home & Kitchen, Kitchen, Beauty & Personal Care, Clothing Shoes & Jewelry, Toys & Games, Sports & Outdoors, Books, Pet Supplies, Automotive, Health & Household, Computers & Accessories, Cell Phones & Accessories, Video Games, Tools & Home Improvement, Patio Lawn & Garden, Baby Products, Office Products, Musical Instruments, Camera & Photo, Grocery & Gourmet Food, Amazon Devices & Accessories. Add several categories to scan past Amazon's 500-deal window.
categories.title: Categories / departments

collection.description: Restrict to one of Amazon's curated deal collections. The collection names differ by marketplace; unsupported collections return a clear status record instead of unfiltered data.
collection.title: Deal collection

discountMax.description: Keep deals with at most this percentage off, filtered by Amazon itself.
discountMax.title: Maximum discount (%)

discountMin.description: Keep deals with at least this percentage off, filtered by Amazon itself.
discountMin.title: Minimum discount (%)

marketplace.description: Which Amazon domain's Today's Deals page to scrape.
marketplace.title: Amazon marketplace

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted deal records. Amazon exposes up to 500 deals per category/collection query; add categories to partition the window.
maxItems.title: Max items

minRating.description: Keep only deals whose product rating is at least this value. Deals without a rating are excluded when this is set.
minRating.title: Minimum rating

priceMax.description: Keep deals at or below this price in the marketplace's local currency.
priceMax.title: Maximum deal price

priceMin.description: Keep deals at or above this price in the marketplace's local currency.
priceMin.title: Minimum deal price

primeExclusiveOnly.description: Only return deals in Amazon's Prime Exclusive collection.
primeExclusiveOnly.title: Prime Exclusive deals only

sortBy.description: Featured keeps Amazon's order. Other sorts read the fetched deal window before returning, so they may take longer.
sortBy.title: Sort results

title: Amazon Deals Grid Tracker Input
